correctness.rationale: Orthogonal star Laplacian eigenspaces have attenuation (1+w)^{-1} on leaf differences and [1+(m+1)w]^{-1} on hub-versus-leaf mean. For activation state (h,k), exact polarization/ε²=A(k−k²/m)+B(h−k/m)² with A=(1+w)^−2 and B=m/[(m+1)(1+(m+1)w)²]. Hub cascade yields h=1,K~Bin(m,p); leaf cascade yields (0,1) with 1−p, or (1,1+Bin(m−1,p)) with p. Taking binomial first two moments and subtracting gives the affine-in-p bracket and prefactor (m−1)(1−p)²/m². For m≥3 its intercept is negative and value at p=1 positive, yielding one p*∈(0,1); for m=1 both seeds symmetric, m=2 leaf strictly wins. Expected reach gap is (m−1)p(1−p). Independent sign checks used 15 weighted-star settings, not as all-size proof.
